mapper.sql: CASE WHEN u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'WITHDRAWN' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_freeze mf WHERE mf.user_id = u.user_id AND CURDATE() BETWEEN mf.freeze_start AND mf.freeze_end) THEN 'FROZEN' WHEN u.is_active = 1 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'SUSPENDED' END

SELECT u.user_id AS id, u.email, u.role, up.name, up.contact AS phone, up.gender, up.birth_date, up.member_type, up.tier, up.trainer_id, tp.name AS trainer_name, up.pt_sessions_left, up.service_pt_sessions_left, AS status, CASE WHEN up.join_date_unknown = 1 THEN NULL ELSE DATE(u.created_at) END AS join_date, (SELECT start_date FROM membership ms WHERE ms.user_id = u.user_id AND ms.status IS NULL ORDER BY ms.end_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS membership_start, (SELECT end_date FROM membership ms WHERE ms.user_id = u.user_id AND ms.status IS NULL ORDER BY ms.end_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS membership_end, (SELECT COALESCE(p.name, pkg.name) FROM membership ms LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = ms.product_id LEFT JOIN product_package pkg ON pkg.id = ms.package_id WHERE ms.user_id = u.user_id AND ms.status IS NULL ORDER BY ms.end_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS current_product_name, (SELECT ms.price - ms.discount_amount FROM membership ms WHERE ms.user_id = u.user_id AND ms.status IS NULL ORDER BY ms.end_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS current_product_price, (SELECT (ms.price - ms.discount_amount) - ms.paid_amount FROM membership ms WHERE ms.user_id = u.user_id AND ms.status IS NULL ORDER BY ms.end_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS unpaid_amount, NULL AS memo, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_auth ua2 JOIN user_profiles up2 ON up2.user_id = ua2.user_id WHERE up2.name = up.name AND up.contact IS NOT NULL AND up.contact != '' AND REPLACE(REPLACE(up2.contact, '-', ''), ' ', '') = REPLACE(REPLACE(up.contact, '-', ''), ' ', '') ) AS app_installed FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.user_id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles tp ON tp.user_id = up.trainer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, MAX(attend_date) AS last_attend FROM attendance GROUP BY user_id) la ON la.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = u.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1
WHERE u.role IN ('MEMBER', 'TRAINER')

sql.if: AND DATEDIFF((SELECT end_date FROM membership ms WHERE ms.user_id = u.user_id AND ms.status IS NULL ORDER BY ms.end_date DESC LIMIT 1), CURDATE()) >= #{minDaysLeft}
AND DATEDIFF((SELECT end_date FROM membership ms WHERE ms.user_id = u.user_id AND ms.status IS NULL ORDER BY ms.end_date DESC LIMIT 1), CURDATE()) <= #{maxDaysLeft}
AND (la.last_attend IS NULL OR DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), la.last_attend) >= #{minAbsentDays})

mapper.select: AND u.user_id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM user_gym WHERE user_id = #{id} AND gym_id = #{gymId} AND is_active = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM user_profiles up JOIN users u ON u.user_id = up.user_id WHERE up.name = #{name} AND up.contact = #{phone} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT u.user_id FROM user_profiles up JOIN users u ON u.user_id = up.user_id WHERE up.name = #{name} AND up.contact = #{phone} AND u.role = 'MEMBER' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (user_id, email, role, is_active) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, 'MEMBER', 1)

INSERT INTO user_profiles (user_id, name, contact, gender, birth_date, join_date_unknown, member_type, tier) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{joinDateUnknown}, #{memberType}, #{tier})
INSERT INTO member_freeze (user_id, freeze_start, freeze_end, reason) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{freezeStart}, #{freezeEnd}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, up.name AS member_name, f.freeze_start, f.freeze_end, f.reason, f.created_at FROM member_freeze f LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON f.user_id = up.user_id WHERE f.user_id=#{memberId} ORDER BY f.freeze_start DESC

SELECT ms.*, p.name AS product_name, pkg.name AS package_name FROM membership ms LEFT JOIN product p ON ms.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_package pkg ON ms.package_id = pkg.id WHERE ms.user_id=#{memberId} AND ms.gym_id=#{gymId} ORDER BY ms.start_date DESC

SELECT ms.*, p.name AS product_name, pkg.name AS package_name FROM membership ms LEFT JOIN product p ON ms.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_package pkg ON ms.package_id = pkg.id WHERE ms.id=#{id} AND ms.gym_id=#{gymId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership (user_id, gym_id, product_id, package_id, locker_id, type, start_date, end_date, price, discount_amount, paid_amount, payment_method, reg_type, session_count, status, memo) VALUES (#{m.memberId}, #{gymId}, #{m.productId}, #{m.packageId}, #{m.lockerId}, #{m.type}, #{m.startDate}, #{m.endDate}, #{m.price}, #{m.discountAmount}, #{m.paidAmount}, #{m.paymentMethod}, #{m.regType}, #{m.sessionCount}, #{m.status}, #{m.memo})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(end_date) AS lastEndDate FROM membership WHERE user_id = #{memberId} AND type IN ('MEMBERSHIP', 'PT')
mapper.update: UPDATE membership SET end_date=#{endDate} WHERE id=#{id} AND gym_id=#{gymId}
UPDATE membership SET price=#{price}, discount_amount=#{discountAmount}, paid_amount=#{paidAmount}, payment_method=#{paymentMethod}, reg_type=#{regType} WHERE id=#{id} AND gym_id=#{gymId}
UPDATE membership SET status='TRANSFERRED' WHERE id=#{id} AND gym_id=#{gymId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM membership WHERE id=#{id} AND gym_id=#{gymId}
DELETE FROM membership WHERE user_id=#{memberId} AND package_id=#{packageId} AND gym_id=#{gymId}
mapper.select: SELECT ms.id, ms.user_id, ms.type, ms.start_date, ms.end_date, p.name AS product_name, up.name AS member_name, up.contact AS member_phone, DATEDIFF(ms.end_date, CURDATE()) AS days_left FROM membership ms JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = ms.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN product p ON ms.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON ms.user_id = up.user_id WHERE ms.status IS NULL AND ms.end_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY ms.end_date ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ms.user_id) FROM membership ms JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = ms.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 WHERE ms.status IS NULL AND ms.end_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM membership ms WHERE ms.user_id = u.user_id AND ms.status IS NULL AND ms.end_date >= CURDATE() ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM membership ms WHERE ms.user_id = u.user_id AND ms.status IS NULL AND ms.end_date >= CURDATE() ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired, SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM membership ms WHERE ms.user_id = u.user_id AND ms.status IS NULL AND ms.end_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiring FROM users u JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = u.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 WHERE u.role IN ('MEMBER', 'TRAINER')

SELECT ticket_type AS ticketType, remaining FROM member_tickets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ticket_type IN ('ONE_POINT', 'FEEDBACK', 'PHOTO', 'VIDEO') ORDER BY FIELD(ticket_type, 'ONE_POINT', 'FEEDBACK', 'PHOTO', 'VIDEO')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mt.ticket_type='ONE_POINT' THEN mt.remaining ELSE 0 END), 0) AS onePoint, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mt.ticket_type='FEEDBACK' THEN mt.remaining ELSE 0 END), 0) AS feedback, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mt.ticket_type='PHOTO' THEN mt.remaining ELSE 0 END), 0) AS photo, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mt.ticket_type='VIDEO' THEN mt.remaining ELSE 0 END), 0) AS video FROM member_tickets mt JOIN users u ON u.user_id = mt.user_id AND u.role = 'MEMBER' AND u.is_active = 1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = u.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 WHERE mt.ticket_type IN ('ONE_POINT', 'FEEDBACK', 'PHOTO', 'VIDEO') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_freeze mf WHERE mf.user_id = u.user_id AND CURDATE() BETWEEN mf.freeze_start AND mf.freeze_end )
SELECT remaining FROM member_tickets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ticket_type = #{ticketType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_tickets (user_id, ticket_type, remaining) VALUES (#{userId}, #{ticketType}, GREATEST(0, #{amount})) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE remaining = GREATEST(0, remaining + #{amount})
INSERT INTO ticket_logs (user_id, ticket_type, action_type, description) VALUES (#{userId}, #{ticketType}, #{actionType}, #{description})

SELECT tl.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(up.name, tl.user_id) AS userName, tl.ticket_type AS ticketType, tl.action_type AS actionType, tl.description, DATE_FORMAT(tl.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt FROM ticket_logs tl
ORDER BY tl.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_logs tl
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE role = 'MEMBER' AND is_active = 1

SELECT u.user_id AS member_id, up.name AS member_name, up.contact AS member_phone, up.tier, COALESCE(up.pt_sessions_left, 0) AS purchased_pt, COALESCE(up.service_pt_sessions_left, 0) AS service_pt, tup.name AS trainer_name FROM users u JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = u.user_id JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = u.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN user_profiles tup ON tup.user_id = up.trainer_id WHERE u.role = 'MEMBER' AND u.is_active = 1 AND (COALESCE(up.pt_sessions_left, 0) + COALESCE(up.service_pt_sessions_left, 0)) > 0 AND (COALESCE(up.pt_sessions_left, 0) + COALESCE(up.service_pt_sessions_left, 0)) < 5 ORDER BY (COALESCE(up.pt_sessions_left, 0) + COALESCE(up.service_pt_sessions_left, 0)) ASC, up.name ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u JOIN user_profiles up ON up.user_id = u.user_id JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = u.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 WHERE u.role = 'MEMBER' AND u.is_active = 1 AND (COALESCE(up.pt_sessions_left, 0) + COALESCE(up.service_pt_sessions_left, 0)) > 0 AND (COALESCE(up.pt_sessions_left, 0) + COALESCE(up.service_pt_sessions_left, 0)) < 5
mapper.update: UPDATE user_profiles up JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = up.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 SET up.pt_sessions_left = GREATEST(0, up.pt_sessions_left + #{delta}) WHERE up.user_id = #{memberId}

UPDATE user_profiles up JOIN user_gym ug ON ug.user_id = up.user_id AND ug.gym_id = #{gymId} AND ug.is_active = 1 SET up.service_pt_sessions_left = GREATEST(0, up.service_pt_sessions_left + #{delta}) WHERE up.user_id = #{memberId}
